# **👥 The Team**

We met as engineering school freshmen at Carnegie Mellon University in 2015, when we both joined the same competitive Bhangra dance team. Over the next 10 years, we lived together, worked together in school projects, and both received Master’s degrees from CMU’s Robotics Institute. We always knew we would start a company together.

Hardik was previously robotics team lead at an agtech startup where he pivoted the team to a new product and made sales within 1 month. He was selected as commencement speaker for the CMU School of Computer Science Masters ceremony by his professors in recognition of his leadership.

Hans was previously a Staff Software Engineer at Boston Dynamics, where he worked on productizing computer vision algorithms for the Spot inspection robot. Before that, he built GPS-denied drone autonomy at a startup and conducted legged robotics research at CMU’s Robotics Institute.

launches.tagline: Turn parts and task requirements into working machine designs in minutes, not years.
launches.body:
We’re Ayna and Andrew, and we’re building [MorphoAI](https://morpho.ai/). We’re a team of manufacturing tech experts and MIT PhDs who have written 30+ papers on foundational research of AI design methods for robotics engineering. We met at Harvard last year and decided to help people develop hardware at the speed of software. 

In our research, we demonstrated capabilities that allowed engineers to generate 100s of verified optimal designs from parts and task requirements in minutes, and now we’re translating those findings to a product for robotics & automation. We’re cutting R&D cycles by 50 %+ and letting teams ship better hardware, faster!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iGmXIsoUc2Y&feature=youtu.be

### **Problem**

Designing a new robot, machine, or work‑cell still feels like 1985: weeks of manual CAD drawing, long prototype‑and‑test loops, and “does it even work?” uncertainty. A single product can take 40‑100 iterations and burn through months of engineering time. This all amounts to $240B spent on mechanical design each year. https://www.morpho.ai/ 

### **Our Take**

What if you could take requirements and ideas into _validated machine designs_ automatically? We’re building that for hardware—so engineers can explore more, better-performing designs, fine-tune the ones likely to work, and land on an optimal design before the first part is cut. Engineers input and tasks and constraints (_what the robot must do)_ and their favorite parts to build with, and MorphoAI’s software auto‑generates, verifies, and fine tunes manufacturable designs in minutes—cutting R&D cycles by 50 %+ and letting teams ship new hardware faster. 

### **The MorphoAI Platform**

1. **Generate** hundreds of verified design candidates from parts and task requirements in minutes, and select the concepts to fine-tune.
2. **Simulate** full‑dynamical behavior with optimal, verified controllers.
3. **Optimize** for cost, performance, weight, manufacturability, and more.

The result is a ready‑to‑manufacture machine design, programmable motions, and BOM—delivered in minutes, not months.

### **Team**

* **Ayna Arora** (CEO, Co-founder) – Harvard Business School; Former VC, 2x founder in manufacturing tech setting up factories across the world.
* **Andy Spielberg, PhD** (CTO, Co-founder) – MIT CSAIL; Harvard PostDoc (digital manufacturing). 30+ papers on Optimization algorithms in robotics design.
* Founding team: Allan Zhao (MIT PhD on GenAI for robot design), Amira Abdel-Rahman (Havard + MIT PhD on design for hardware) Han Wang (simulation expert in research+industry).

We’re also backed by ARIA (UK Government’s Invention Agency) with a 2.5MM GBP Grant.

### **What’s Possible Today**

Our early users are:

* Resizing robot geometry and motors to maximize reach and payloads.
* Redesigning workcells to minimize costs, design time, and improve margins.
* Auto-generating new end-of-arm tooling designs from parts in hours, not weeks

### **Big Picture**

MorphoAI is the “compiler” for the physical world. As we expand our capabilities, any company will be able to invent machines that were previously infeasible— shrinking $MM R&D budgets and accelerating everything from factory automation to medical innovation to planetary exploration.

### **Let’s Talk**

Building a new robot or a new cutting-edge machine? We’d love to talk. Drop us a note at [**hello@morpho.ai**](mailto:hello@morpho.ai) .

launches.body:
We manufacture pharmaceutical drugs faster than current methods and in the USA. We are building microfactories that can handle the upcoming wave of AI-designed drugs and safeguard against biothreats.

[Launch Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=W_lJOs7k7nI)

### **The Problem**

America is at risk of ceding leadership in advanced biomanufacturing to China.

* **Drug manufacturing is moving to China;** 79% of US biotech and pharma companies already have at least one contract with a Chinese firm, _primarily because they are faster._
* **China is investing billions in biotech**; one third of new compounds licensed by US pharma are now _discovered and manufactured_ in China, up from almost none five years ago.
* **Over-reliance on foreign biomanufacturing is a national-security risk;** agile, on-shore manufacturing is critical to protect our nation against future biothreats.

### **Our Solution**

A contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) for advanced drugs, rebuilt from the ground up to address the future of America’s biomanufacturing needs.

* **Faster biomanufacturing**; Our platform leverages advanced methods to accelerate production timelines and de-risk scale-up.
* **Modular container factories**; our form factor is a standard shipping container that can be brought up to operation in roughly two weeks and shipped where it is needed.
* **Supply-chain independence;** by vertically integrating and manufacturing critical equipment in-house, we secure production against global disruptions.

### **Why It Matters**

* **Drugs can be developed faster**; shorter production cycles move life-saving drugs from the lab to the clinic up to a year sooner.
* **More drugs can be developed**; we will be able to manufacture the thousands of low-volume, personalized biologics that will be designed by AI.
* **Strengthening US autonomy;** rapid-deploy, U.S.-based capacity protects the nation from supply shocks, geopolitical turbulence, and potential bioweapons.

### **Who We Are**

We love biomanufacturing. Together, we built Protein Evolution, an industrial biotech company that turned plastic waste into new textile fibers. Scott is ex-McKinsey and a Yale mathematician (he loves a good cost model almost as much as he loves America). Mike earned his PhD in Bioengineering from Penn after completing Penn’s M&T program in undergrad (he builds DNA, software, and bioreactors).

launches.title: Vision Lab: The Industrial Data Layer for Robotics
launches.tagline: Aggregating the Largest Manufacturing Process Data for Robotics Training
launches.body:
## **TL;DR**

We capture and structure real factory workflows at scale, pairing first-person industrial video with SOP-level process knowledge, so robotics and AI labs can train models on the data that actually exists inside production environments, not just lab demos. We are already working with 2 frontier AI labs.

🎥 **Our 60-second Product Launch**:\
<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=u2CyfEnYY5A>

## **THE PROBLEM**

The robotics industry is being trained mostly on lab demos, even though robots will ultimately need to operate in messy, high-variance real factories. The industry has **less than 0.3% of the data it needs**, and almost none of it comes from real factory environments.

Why?

**Industrial data does not exist at scale**\
It cannot be scraped or passively collected. It has to be captured inside real factories, on real production lines, during real operations.

**Raw footage is not enough**\
Unstructured industrial video is noise. Models need process context: what step is happening, in what order, with what tools, and whether it was done correctly.

**Crowdsourcing cannot solve it**\
Understanding industrial actions requires factory expertise. Anyone can label an object; far fewer can distinguish whether a torque check, weld, inspection, or setup sequence was performed correctly.

---

## **THE SOLUTION**

Vision Lab solves the industrial data problem by building:

**The most diverse industrial dataset**\
SOP-structured production data spanning cutting-edge environments like biotech, EV manufacturing, semiconductors, and medical devices, as well as large-scale manufacturing.

**Industrial access at scale**\
A network of **2,000+ factories across 50+ industries in 27 countries**, with operators and factory owners embedded in the capture process so every sequence, tool, and technique is recorded correctly at the source.

**A proprietary VLM for industrial settings**\
A temporal VLM trained on SOP-paired industrial footage to understand not just what is happening, but the **order, timing, and correctness** of real industrial processes. Our state-of-the-art VLM outperforms Gemini by **2.5x on temporal understanding in industrial settings**.

---

## **PARTNER WITH US**

If you believe the next decade of robotics and world models will depend on **real-world industrial data, not just compute**, we’d love to talk.

Vision Lab partners with robotics labs, frontier AI teams, and manufacturers to build the default industrial data layer for robotics.

**Contact:** [founders@thevisionlab.ai](mailto:founders@thevisionlab.ai)\
**More info**: [www.thevisionlab.ai](http://www.thevisionlab.ai)

### **TL;DR**

LineWise is building an AI assistant for manufacturing teams to get their production lines back up and running - fast.

We connect siloed factory data (PLCs, maintenance logs, manuals) to triage faults, guide technicians to fixes, and capture every resolution for smarter troubleshooting in the future.

🎥 **Our 60-second Product Launch:\
[https://youtu.be/DfnmQ4k8q-k](https://youtu.be/DfnmQ4k8q-k)**

### **THE PROBLEM**

When a line goes down, it can take **hours** to identify the problem. Engineers and technicians chase PLC logs, flip through outdated manuals, and rely on the one person who “just knows.” While production stalls, tribal knowledge disappears, and the same issues repeat.

### **THE SOLUTION**

LineWise centralizes critical knowledge by integrating siloed data from IoT sensors, maintenance records, and machine manuals. It ranks the most likely causes and guides the team to a fix in just **minutes**. But the best part? It remembers every issue for next time and advocates for preventative actions.

---

### **How LineWise Works**

🔧 Upload an error code image or describe the issue in a message.

🤖 The AI provides a refocused problem statement for confirmation.

📊 The AI dynamically ranks possible hypotheses of causes by probability.

🧠 A human validates each hypothesis to identify the true cause.

🛠️ Resolve the issue by following a step-by-step guide.

🔍 Conduct further investigation to uncover the root cause.

📚 Enrich the knowledge base with insights from the issue and resolution.

---

### **Join Us to Revolutionize Manufacturing**

LineWise partners with forward-thinking manufacturers to minimize unplanned downtime, empower frontline teams, and unlock the value of siloed data within a company. 

If that sounds like you, we’d love to talk.

Cascade Space was founded to build the ground station company of the future. But lack of large dishes is not the only thing broken about space communications, so are the design tools. 

Industry standard spreadsheets are painful to build and maintain and error prone, but they can at least get you started. That said, they completely break down once you need to predict how your spacecraft will perform in real world dynamic environments, analyzing multiple variations of a system, or sharing and keeping the design updated across teams.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=96236&key=user_uploads/222992/5bdf36f9-9f71-4796-9f12-ecbeba37d8c4)

Every space company eventually starts to build internal tooling to parse 3D antenna patterns and scripts to evaluate link performance over given flight trajectories. This is usually unplanned work done by RF engineers that takes months to get even a rudimentary implementation up and running. This software is very bespoke and often brittle, and makes the tight timelines of early stage companies even tighter.

Across the industry this work gets duplicated over, and over, and over. 

**Enter Cascade Designer**. The pipeline is already built. Start by designing your system in a graphical interface, get your link margin with a single button click. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=96236&key=user_uploads/222992/7e4a5642-dc70-4093-a7d5-5a2b1802cda3)

Next, analyze entire trajectories with a single API call. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=96236&key=user_uploads/222992/980c9907-784c-4861-8758-b6341afd2721)

Designs can be shared with anyone on your team through our interface

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=96236&key=user_uploads/222992/bec0b967-999c-4089-849f-d0c547431498)

We built this out because the customers of the best ground network need the best design tools, but we didn’t just build this for our ground station customers. Anyone designing a spacecraft for any orbit using any ground station can use it. 

Visit our website to learn more and book your demo: https://cascade.space/designer/

launches.title: Cascade Space - Deep space communications as a service
launches.tagline: Your next lunar mission just got easier!
launches.body:
# tl;dr

Cascade Space is building a turn-key communications system for lunar and deep space missions. Our ground station network and integrated software tools work together to maximize uptime and availability, while reducing spacecraft iteration cycles from weeks to hours. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90423&key=user_uploads/222992/7b3a56ce-8dc0-48db-a2e5-3badb2afd893)

**Why are we building this and why now?**

The Deep Space Network (DSN), NASA’s global network of ground terminals for communicating with deep space probes, is [oversubscribed by 40% and in desperate need of upgrades.](https://newspaceeconomy.ca/2024/09/02/nasas-deep-space-network-challenges-and-the-road-ahead/) The DSN is all but unavailable for most commercial operations. Companies with missions going to the Moon and beyond have to deal with a patchwork of individual dish operators for every mission, each with bespoke hardware, specs, and interfaces. Furthermore, many of these commercial providers are not able to handle the demand and [operational failures also can lead to loss of mission](https://www.astroforge.com/updates-collection/odint-mission-debrief).

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90423&key=user_uploads/222992/c6aa8968-e567-42e5-8866-866414630f22)

**Comms system design is fraught with peril**

The spacecraft comms system design is tightly coupled to the available ground network. Engineers spend hundreds of hours poring over datasheets, on the phone with vendors and suppliers, and endless email threads, only to put all this data into a giant spreadsheet to make sense of it. Every iteration requires not only painful attention to detail, but also in-depth esoteric knowledge of how radio frequency systems and channel coding schemes work in order to accurately predict in-flight performance. Simple misunderstandings can lead to catastrophic errors in design and configuration.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90423&key=user_uploads/222992/1623d16f-4789-4793-892f-2c7adffc84a7)

**End-to-end comms system validation often doesn’t happen**

Fully integrated testing between the spacecraft and ground terminal is typically cost prohibitive. Instead, engineers compare spec sheets and email configurations to the ground operators, and hope it works in flight (spoiler alert: it often doesn’t). It is routine for spacecraft to fly having never done an end-to-end test of their system with ground terminal representative hardware. The whole process is subject to human error from end to end. 

**This approach to space communications does not scale**

Commercial space ventures beyond low earth orbit have already pushed existing infrastructure to its breaking point, and demand for deep space comms support is expected to grow exponentially over the next decade. We will not have a spacefaring future for humanity until communications for spacecraft become as easy as signing up for cable internet. 

**We are redefining the process, starting with spacecraft design**

Better comms starts at the beginning, in the early trade study and design phase. We are replacing industry-standard spreadsheets with a modern software tool that lets you see how your system will perform with our ground network in real time.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90423&key=user_uploads/222992/4873c5a0-9288-48fe-8d2e-a3a32f3fcad0)

**Test as you fly, fly as you test**

You don’t rise to the level of your expectations, you fall to the level of your testing. We ship you a “ground station in a box,” identical to hardware we’ve installed at the ground stations you will be using, and provide you with a test plan that you can use to test your entire system end to end, with both the space vehicle and the ground terminal in the loop. 

**Launch with confidence**

Fly and operate your spacecraft. Use our API to schedule passes on our network, track your spacecraft, stream data, monitor the ground site, and access recordings.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90423&key=user_uploads/222992/2b01ca98-b6d7-4f8b-9af5-5b93b0613ef0)

**We are rolling out our preliminary network rapidly**

We start by partnering with owners of dishes that are currently unused for any other telemetry applications. This allows us to build out the product and acquire customers with a minimal amount of capital. As we build out the network, we will further expand our network by strategically building our own ground stations in key locations. Our first downlink only ground stations are expected to come online in 2025, with more to follow in 2026.

**We are passionate about your mission success**

[Jacob](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/company/30556) and [Arlen](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/2222230) have solved many of these exact problems at company level scales in previous roles. Jacob was RF system architect at SpaceX and Arlen has built complex hardware/software systems his entire career. Collectively they have spent hundreds of hours in mission control, many of those hours dealing with anomalies and outright failures. They are both passionate about building the culture of excellence at Cascade that is required for flawless mission execution.

**If you are struggling with comms for your upcoming mission, drop us a line. We can help.**

https://cascade.space/

launches.title: Parametric: RL for Robotics
launches.tagline: Robots that learn from customer feedback
launches.body:
**TL;DR**

Existing robots learn generic averages from massive datasets. Our robots learn from customer feedback.

We solve the RL feedback loop for robotics, allowing our robots to learn from _your_ specific standards via an automated reward pipeline that combines customer feedback with an intelligent judge model. This is the only way to capture the multi-trillion dollar “long tail” of unique, high-aggregate-value business tasks. 

We’re live with real customers today and aggressively improving model performance. Our team led autonomy at Parallel Systems (series B startup; 100M raised) and scaled AI revenue for Facebook’s recommendation systems.

https://youtu.be/EhiYJT52EJY

**The Problem**

The real market for general purpose robotics is a multi-trillion dollar **“long tail” of differentiated tasks.** This is the market that traditional automation can’t touch. The core technology to solve this is _finally_ viable, but the long tail means the only path to success is adaptation to millions of specific customers' needs. 

We’ve spoken to countless customers. No one has ever asked for a human form factor. They demand three things: **reliability, throughput, and control**. They want boxes packed in a specific order or towels folded lengthwise twice. Traditional learning algorithms don’t give this customer specificity.

When you work backwards from these _actual_ customer requirements it becomes clear that we’re missing the bridge between customer feedback and model improvement.

**Our Approach**

We build **robots** that learn from customer feedback and improve continuously. 

1. Adaptive Intelligence: At its core, an automated pipeline that combines customer feedback with a judge model to RL fine-tune a model and steer it towards positive behaviors, as defined by customers.
2. Pragmatic Hardware: A mobile robot with a wheeled base and bimanual arms. Designed for long uptime and high throughput.

 

Our models can learn new behaviors on-site with less than an hour of data, delivering low cost, effective automation immediately. 

If you’d like to learn more, please reach out to us: [hello@parametric.company](mailto:hello@parametric.company).

launches.title: Verne Robotics: Robot Arms that Learn New Skills in Hours
launches.tagline: The Robots of the Future, Arriving Today
launches.body:
**TL;DR:** We’ve developed the SOTA model for controlling robot arms, allowing our arms to learn new skills in hours instead of weeks. This enables rapid deployment and a unique business model where we can let companies pay by-the-hour, instead of requiring massive capex. We already have a biotech unicorn using our robots in production to package delicate chemical vials.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WHzjweFnbkk&feature=youtu.be

# **The Problem: Robots are difficult to deploy & have fixed workflows**

Traditional robot arms often require months of custom engineering and planning to integrate. These bulky, rigid, and expensive systems take up substantial floor space and are hard-coded for a single workflow. Adapting to new tasks means weeks of downtime and reprogramming. As a result, companies often default to increasing headcount to keep up with demand.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=92471&key=user_uploads/1318663/7be314c8-ffa9-46e3-82cf-34b72e78c2cd)

# **What we do: Drop-in autonomous robot arms that deploy in days**

Our first product – Nemo3 – is a bimanual robot that can handle objects within a 2.5-foot radius, supports payloads up to 4 lbs, and can be mounted flexibly in various environments. Unlike traditional robot arms, Nemo3 rapidly learns new tasks and adapts to changing conditions on the fly. Our AI decomposes 30 minutes of tele-operation data into skills and uses diffusion models to learn each skill. The result is fast and robust automation for our customers. 

As one of our customers put it: “What surprised me most was how fast you set it up. After one weekend it was set up.” It took us just 4 days to get the robot deployed at ABClonal - from unpacking the robot to automating the vial packing task.

# **Who needs this**

Our robots excel at dexterous manipulation tasks. Here are a few industries we can help:

* DTC Meal Kits: Speed up meal kit assembly with automated packing. 
* Consumer Packaged Goods: Automate kitting to create variety packs with mixed SKUs. 
* Warehouses/Logistics: Sort parcels and pack irregular items faster and at lower cost.
* Biotech: No more manual clean room disinfection or glovebox work

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=92471&key=user_uploads/1318663/13eac3c1-2454-494a-9bcc-85819cd28f34)

# **Our Ask**

Do you know any manufacturers, distributors, or logistics companies burning time & money on repetitive manual tasks? Maybe they’ve tried other solutions and think it’s impossible to automate?

Reach us at: [founders@vernerobotics.com](mailto:founders@vernerobotics.com)

Book a time: https://cal.com/vernerobotics/30min

# **The Team**

Neil is a leading robot learning researcher from Columbia and Stanford. At Columbia he was advised by Prof. Shuran Song and at Stanford he was advised by Prof. Jiajun Wu, as part of the Vision & Learning Lab led by Prof. Fei-Fei Li. Neil holds two patents on multi-modal perception from his time at Apple, where he helped build the Apple Vision Pro. Neil left his PhD at Berkeley to start Verne Robotics.

Aditya led Azure Copilot from private preview to GA Launch on Microsoft’s product team. He graduated Phi Betta Kappa from Cornell University. 

🤝 We met in high school tinkering with robots and now our mission is giving every company access to automation.

launches.tagline: We empower cattle farmers with early disease detection and reproductive insights.
launches.body:
**TLDR:** Nexa builds implantable “FitBits” + AI for cattle monitoring. We empower farmers with early disease detection and reproductive insights that save them time and money.

https://youtu.be/goioQTngpSU

**Problem**

Efficiently monitoring cattle health and reproduction is critical to maintain farm profitability. But the traditional practice of manually inspecting animals doesn’t scale - labor costs add up, while farms miss disease outbreaks and breeding cycles. Disease alone causes \~$100 billion in losses yearly for cattle farms globally.

Existing tech for monitoring cattle includes external wearables like collars and ear-tags. Being outside thick cattle skin, these can’t accurately track useful biometrics beyond “activity” (a glorified step-count). There’s also boluses, pill-shaped devices that sit in the cow stomach. But these are super expensive, have short battery life, and can’t be used for beef cattle.

**Solution**

Nexa is building implantable microchips that go underneath the skin in the ear of cattle. We analyze vital biometrics - like temperature, heart rate, blood oxygen, activity, GPS location, and more - that other systems miss, to empower farmers with early disease detection and reproductive insights. And because our electronics operate at millimeter scale, we benefit from low production costs and pricing up to 70% cheaper than current solutions.

Our hardware also enables collection of the world’s largest cattle health dataset - so, we can develop foundation models that can unlock new possibilities in farm management and livestock pharma. 

We’re currently launching our dairy pilot program - if you know any dairy farmers based in the USA, please send them our way at [admin@nexa.farm](mailto:admin@nexa.farm) :)

**About Us**

We’re a team of Caltech dropouts with backgrounds in bioengineering, electrical engineering, CS, math, and physics. We want to build technology that makes a tangible impact on the lives of real people in America and beyond.

launches.body:
**Contact:** [founders@useflai.com](mailto:founders@useflai.com)

**TL;DR**

✅ **24/7 AI assistant** that books test drives & service appointments in seconds\
✅ **Smart outbound AI assistant** that handles recalls and appointment reminders\
✅ **Plug-and-play integrations** with dealer DMS/CRM; live in stores today

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xO1TXqmllIQ

❌ **The Problem**

Dealerships are trapped in a never-ending cycle that bleeds revenue:

* **60% of dealership leads arrive after business hours** and most dealers can't answer
* **70% who hit voicemail contact a competitor within 30 minutes**, losing the sale
* **Each store loses $1M annually** from those missed calls alone
* **Staffed coverage is costly, inconsistent, and impossible to scale**

✨ **Our Solution**

Flai's Dealership-Tailored AI Assistants gives every dealership a tireless voice agent with three core capabilities:

* **Always-On Coverage:** Our AI agents answer or dial every single customer 24/7, so no inquiry or follow-up slips through the cracks
* **Multi-Channel Communications:** Calls, SMS, and email work together to book test-drives, service slots, and recall visits the moment customers are ready
* **Dealer-Ready & Secure:** Fast DMS/CRM integration, full call logs, and SOC 2 Type II compliance, built for automotive retail from day one

Dealers switch it on in an afternoon and instantly reach **100% call coverage** with zero wait time.

🛠️ **Why Now?**

The pain and the cure have finally converged.

* **There's a phone-lead crisis unfolding:** 50% of inbound calls never reach a rep, and dealerships leak $1M+ annually from poor phone coverage
* **Multiple breakthroughs in voice AI:** Agents have reached human-level fluency this year. The technology is finally ready

👥 **Backstory & Team**

Ari waited for 30min on hold while booking a service appointment and the idea clicked: unanswered phones are bleeding dealerships dry. That same weekend we dropped in on ten dealerships, got our initial prospect (which we signed a few days later), and decided then and there to solve it.

We’re Adith and Kenny — the founders of Riff!

# **TL;DR**

[Riff](https://goriff.com) is a **music editor with superpowers** where experienced producers can be 10x more productive and hobbyists can delight in making music without needing technical chops.

[**https://youtu.be/bjyjtr8-yz8**](https://youtu.be/bjyjtr8-yz8)

# **Problem**

**Slow**

🖥️ ❌ Legacy music production software is clunky and weighed down by archaic UX.

**Repetitive**

🎧 ❌ Musicians sometimes spend hours making changes that should realistically happen in minutes. With legacy software, there is no high-signal way of getting your creativity down.

**High skill barrier**

🎸❌ The difficulty of existing tools blocks people with musical interest but no patience to learn complex audio engineering.

# **Solution**

Riff is an AI music editor meant to make music creation easier, yet still keeps the artist in charge.

🤘 Add sounds in your style directly into the editor using AI

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=92151&key=user_uploads/2491351/381a389e-ba7a-41c9-9954-b5994667ec53)

Adith and Kenny met at Berkeley through a music collective they started (now 1200+ artists large).

🎹 Adith has been making music for \~5 years, has 1M+ streams on Spotify, and is deep into audio AI.

🥁 Kenny has been making music for \~8 years, Ex-Tencent Ex-Amazon, and releases frequently on Spotify.

# **Who’s it for?**

In the short run, we’re targeting aspiring musicians who are between entry level music software like GarageBand and BandLab. Very soon, we’ll have enough features that we can directly compete with FL/Ableton/Logic/Pro Tools and get experienced producers onboard.

launches.body:
### **TLDR:**

Hey everyone! We’re [**John**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/john-huddleston-3584121b7/) (engineer and unmanned systems expert) and [**Dante**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/dante-vaisbort/) (repeat defense founder). [**Albacore Inc.**](https://www.albacore.inc/) is building the next generation of unmanned underwater vehicles (UUVs) to prevent maritime invasions. Our first product is **Ghostfin:** a 6-foot-long autonomous underwater vehicle that can patrol over 1,000 nautical miles undetected and massively damage hostile watercraft.

[**https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UQ6SYgIsDQs**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UQ6SYgIsDQs)

### [**🏴‍☠️**](https://emojipedia.org/pirate-flag) The Problem: America doesn’t have any long-range underwater strike weapons.

In the case of an Indo-Pacific conflict, our military’s existing suite of autonomous underwater vehicles is woefully unprepared. Today’s unmanned underwater vehicles are short-range, expensive, and overly mission-specific. Unlike the Ukrainians or even the Houthis, America doesn’t have underwater vehicles built for attack missions in service.

### **🚀 Our Solution: Low-cost autonomous underwater vehicles that can travel 10x further.**

Range is the key constraint in massive bodies of water like the Pacific Ocean. The Albacore team has spent years working on power technology and manufacturing for unmanned systems, and can build Ghostfin far more efficiently than anything on the market today by using a combination of highly scalable in-house-designed and off-the-shelf components.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=92587&key=user_uploads/2629924/1f9c199a-487c-4de0-848e-94ae31db9ba6)

**John Huddleston, Co-Founder:** John is a mechanical engineer who spent 3 years at the Boston Consulting Group advising government agencies and Fortune 500 companies in the defense industrial base. He worked on >$9b in unmanned systems manufacturing and procurement efforts alongside senior military leadership.

**Dante Vaisbort, Co-Founder:** Dante is a second-time founder in defense, who has won and led more than >$10m in DoD contract efforts for his first company, Haylon Technologies, which builds power technology for autonomous systems and is still active.

We also have an incredible engineering team hailing from Lockheed Martin, Johnson & Johnson etc. who have won underwater vehicle competitions and have a combined 20 years experience on space flight technology, autonomous vehicle AI, medical robotics, and robosubs.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=92587&key=user_uploads/2629924/550044dc-1333-486f-8877-384a1270c501)

### **😇 Our Ask:**

Please reach out to us if you can help us deliver solutions to the Navy, Special Operations Forces, intelligence community, or allied foreign militaries. If you know any commercial entities who may want this, that’s great too!

Stay tuned for us to blow stuff up in the next one. In the meantime, drop us a line at [**founders@albacore.inc**](mailto:founders@albacore.inc)

launches.title: Phases: Automating clinical trials with AI agents, starting in patient recruitment
launches.tagline: Developing life-saving drugs shouldn't take a decade.
launches.body:
Hi YC! We’re Jonathan, Anton, and James - and we’re building **Phases**.

**We’re already live with customers,** helping them fill trials faster, hit recruitment targets, and prevent costly delays, without adding any additional work to research teams.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=10N_b2s4128

## ❌ The Problem

**75% of people die from diseases we still can't cure (WHO).**

Clinical trials are how we bring new treatments to the world, but today it takes over a decade and more than $1 billion to bring a new drug to market. Nowhere is the problem more obvious than in **patient recruitment.**

Recruitment is the biggest bottleneck:

* **Research sites** read 1000s of medical records and run 30+ min screening calls to enroll just 1 in 10 patients, using phones, spreadsheets, and disconnected systems.
* **Patients:** Wait days or weeks to hear back, face slow and frustrating screening processes, and often drop out due to poor communication and lost trust.
* **Pharma companies:** Lose up to $312M per delayed trial (12.2-month average delay), with 80% of studies missing recruitment targets despite spending 30% of their budgets on it.

## 👷 The Solution

Meet **Polly** - the AI recruiter for clinical trials.

Polly is an AI agent that helps research sites find, interview, and schedule patients for clinical trials. She integrates with the tools the team already uses, so there’s nothing new to learn.

Polly handles recruitment end-to-end, with potentially eligible patients automatically landing in research site calendars for their first visit.

**How Polly helps:**

* **Speed:** Saves team's hours per week by automating medical records reviews and turning 30+ minute screening conversations into 1-minute decisions.
* **Scale & Flexibility:** Engages every patient the moment they express interest, 24/7, and scales on-demand, handling thousands of conversations at once without burdening research teams.
* **Cost:** Automates the most labor-intensive parts of patient recruitment, filling trials faster at a fraction of the cost.

## 🚀 The Vision

Polly is just the start. We’re building the digital workforce for clinical research that will run all back-office trial operations so research teams can focus on patients, not paperwork.

For anyone living with or caring for someone with a chronic condition, one thing is clear: **Developing life-saving drugs shouldn't take a decade.**

## 👋 Our Backstory

Our founding team worked on integrating machine learning into the mobile ads app at Meta, developer and deployment experiences at Palantir, and published deep learning research in microsurgical robotics at the University of Toronto. Our CEO, who grew up around clinical trials with a mother overseeing dozens of studies as medical director at J&J, Janssen, and Schering Plough, has designed data science AI agents adopted by leading companies, including J&J and Syneos Health.

## 🙏 Call to Action

If you know anyone running or working in clinical trials at **research sites**, **CROs**, or **pharma companies**, we’d love intros!\
📩 Reach out to us at [**founders@phases.ai**](mailto:founders@phases.ai)

name: Perseus Defense
long_description:
Perseus Defense is building a mass-manufactured Counter UAS solution for the Department of Defense and Department of Homeland Security. Current solutions are one-to-one, too dangerous for use on U.S. soil, and orders of magntiude more expensive than the threats they defeat. Our self-guided missile platform is man-portable and multi-domain capable. It senses, engages, and eliminates threats with drastically reduced cost per engagement over existing kinetic solutions. 

Solving this critical national security problem requires understanding complex DoD needs along with actual rocket science including aerodynamics, guidance, navigation, control, and much more. Jason and Steve met at Penn State while they pursued their PhD and MS in aerospace engineering, respectively. Their past experiences designing space helicopters for NASA, making Boeing airliners land autonomously, controlling swarms of unmanned autonomous systems, teaching aerospace engineering at Stanford, winning multiple ONR and DOE engineering competitions, and founding an international drone competition makes them the perfect team to create transformative solutions protecting our service members. 

"If you build this, it will be mandatory equipment for every truck, boat, and convoy in the U.S. Military. We're talking thousands of units." - Former DoD Procurement Officer

The White House just released Executive Order, "Unleashing American Drone Dominance" which adds billions of dollars, government support, and streamlined regulations to enable the development of our product. 

Traction: 
Jason and Steve used more than 100 end-user interviews across the DoD and DHS to shape the product to something of critical need to both boots on the ground and DoD purchasers. In 8 short weeks following a strict 2-week design-build-test cycle, the team has gone through 4 major guided missile iterations with over 30 live-fire flight tests. They were invited to Ft. Hood to present their platform to the 1st Cavalry Division, and also briefed the Pentagon and U.S. congressmen on current U.S. vulnerabilities to advanced drone technology.  Perseus Defense is actively standing up cooperative research agreements with U.S. Army DEVCOM's Applied Research Laboratory, Aviation and Missile Center, Armaments Center, and High Performance Computing Modernization Program.

launches.tagline: Meet Perseus, the team building affordable micro-missiles to combat drone swarms
launches.body:
Hey everyone [👋](https://emojipedia.org/waving-hand) Happy 4th of July!

We’re [Jason](https://www.linkedin.com/in/jason-k-cornelius/) from NASA and [Steve](https://www.linkedin.com/in/steve-messinger-a32680155/) from Boeing – and now, we’re co-founders of [Perseus Defense](https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/perseus-defense).

# **TL;DR — We're building guided micro-missiles that shoot down drones in combat**

**_Ask_:** Do you know end-users across the Department of Defense (DoD) and Department of Homeland Security (DHS) that could benefit from attritable anti-drone solutions?

https://youtu.be/o17lMdLuZWQ

# **❌ The Problem**

Today’s Counter-Unmanned Aerial System (**CUAS**) solutions are too expensive, too heavy, too slow, and too ineffective.

1. **70-80%** of battlefield fatalities come from drone strikes
2. **$100,000+** kinetic solutions are used to counteract **$500** drones
   * **$500** drones are eliminating **$100M** assets
3. Current solutions are easily defeated with fiber-optic, visual inertial odometry, or simple waypoint navigation missions

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=91870&key=user_uploads/1658535/5caa36d2-7e58-4001-b716-33dadb3e92b5)

_$500 Ukrainian drones decimate $100M Russian strategic bombers_

# 🚀 \*\* Our Solution \*\*

Perseus is creating the first affordable guided micro-missile pods to bolster American defense capabilities both at home and abroad.

Our micro-guided missiles detect, identify, and eliminate incoming threats before they can reach their intended target. They cost less than $10k, which is 2 orders of magnitude less than the current best solutions.

Steve and I felt we could create a better solution to the CUAS problem and decided we had a moral obligation to follow through on that belief. We quit our old jobs and put it all on the line to fast-track this capability for the U.S. and our allies.

![](https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/slidesz/AGV_vUdop9WhSeh84TqDYnuwb3vz1KrIWMQDG2MWaFBwptJ3V92-8mbVSKxJzAVgy3W8RXJF8ovt3OHW-hN49IX6q1nBBLmdsuYzaAOJuATMlBJC1U1FTg9GwtyELc63ytxpmLWJ8Wfqag=s2048?key=GGmIlUfxi3cwLoUUF9rHqQ)

_Perseus Defense Mark-II Guided Missile Test (Prototyped in 1 week)_

![](https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/slidesz/AGV_vUcAN59Yl56m_fFTA4T6Hy9mIwgWRyVILftyiV0zK5LBlNr0z9CtXbGM2Ds7u3F62fX8nX0j0HwFe0P8aahK_00gXESeyeQn8-8JmAdE5u9epJxbPEjHeEY7Gr7vq0ZwTOVYh89E5A=s2048?key=GGmIlUfxi3cwLoUUF9rHqQ)

# **The Team**

Jason and Steve studied aerospace engineering together at Penn State University and founded Perseus Defense in 2025.

**Jason (CEO)** designed NASA’s Titan Dragonfly space helicopter, led a NASA advanced projects team to design a next-generation Mars helicopter, and has contributed to multiple aerospace programs across NASA, the DoD, and commercial sectors. He holds a PhD in aerospace engineering with specializations in aircraft design, supercomputing, and machine learning. Jason also taught Aerodynamics at Stanford, speaks four languages, and founded an international drone competition.

**Steve (CTO)** has worked as a swarm robotics researcher focused on building and deploying real-world autonomy. He won swarm robotics competitions with the Office of Naval Research, built autonomy that allows commercial aircraft to land themselves at Boeing, and developed collaborative behaviors for Unmanned Surface Vehicles at Applied Intuition.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=91870&key=user_uploads/1658535/2c3d3f2c-7cd2-4a48-a4f2-f19631938c29)

_Prepping a UAS-mounted Missile (Prototyped in 1.5 weeks)_

# **🙏 Our Ask:**

If you answer “yes” to any of these, we’d love your help:

* Have you been wondering how $500,000 CUAS solutions are supposed to combat $1,000 drones at scale?
* Can you introduce us to end-users across the DoD or DHS that are looking for better solutions to protect our troops, our country, and our allies?

👉 Contact us at [founders@perseusdefense.com](mailto:founders@perseusdefense.com)

Your help can make a huge difference as we work to protect the folks we care about abroad and here at home. **Thank you!**

name: OS3
long_description:
OS3 is building the platform that makes intelligent robots accessible to every business.

Today, robotics is constrained by two fundamental bottlenecks: hardware is too expensive to deploy at scale, and robots are difficult to train because high-quality robotics data is scarce and costly to collect. 

We built OS3 to solve both.

Our two-person team designed and a US-made mobile humanoid robot for a fraction of the cost of commercial alternatives. On the intelligence side, instead of relying on expensive robot-generated training data, we trained our own video-action model on 150,000 hours of real-world video spanning more than 2,000 tasks. Every deployed robot feeds new experience into our reinforcement learning pipeline, self improving robot fleet over time.

This creates a robot that can be deployed across industries to automate repetitive, physical work without requiring a new robot or training pipeline for every task. Our robots are already deployed in hotels, with customers now expanding the platform into biotech, hospitals, and data centers, including a wet lab at Stanford.

Our mission is to do for robotics what Apple did for personal computing: take technology that was once expensive, specialized, and inaccessible and make it powerful and usable at massive scale. We’re building toward a world with billions of intelligent robots, and OS3 is the platform that makes that possible.

launches.title: OS3: Intelligence and Machines for Physical Labor
launches.tagline: Semi-humanoid hardware & Model based on 150k hours of Videos. Preorders Live Now
launches.body:
**TL;DR: OS3 is building semi-humanoid robots for physical labor. Our first robot, H.A.L.E 1.0, is built for everyday human tasks, and our first model is based on 2,000+ distinct real-world tasks and 150,000 hours of video data. We are opening up pre-orders to all with shipments starting this Fall.**

**Physical AI Problem:**

A lot of teams and businesses want to build and deploy in the robotics space. But they have to source parts or buy hardware from different vendors. Furthermore, the recent import ban makes it even harder for beginners and startups to use the latest hardware, unless they are willing to spend tens of thousands of dollars. Post hardware, constant data collection is needed to adapt open or closed-source models to the ever changing hardware choices. In other words, everyone keeps reinventing the same wheel of modern robotics development over and over again. 

**Our solution:**

[**Video Link**](https://youtu.be/dDwaQbZYPLQ)

We built OS3: Both the hardware from ground up and the model to control the hardware. Our first robot, H.A.L.E. 1.0 (Human Aligned Life Enhancing), is designed to handle a wide range of everyday physical tasks, and we are presenting the prototype unit today.

Our goal is towards pushing American robotics forward while ensuring the state of the art is available to all. 

**Hardware and Model:** 

It features a bimanual embodiment with an omni-directional base, full height control to pick up objects directly from the ground while being able to reach top shelves, and a battery that can last a whole work day. Additionally, our design is primarily focused on safety and user-friendliness; a person can start and stop a task at just the touch of a screen on the back of the robot or a mobile app. 

The intelligence layer is a two system architecture, with a high level planner layer and a lower level execution layer. The model has been trained on 150,000 hours of video data spanning over 2,000 real world tasks. Technical report coming soon, once evaluation runs finish. Hardware specs and engineering deep dive posted on our website.

name: F4 Industries
long_description:
GD&T takes years to master. Engineers must encode their design intent into a dense syntax that manufacturers must decode, and not everyone gets it right. 

Put ten engineers in front of the same drawing and you may get ten different interpretations. Which means errors often surface later in interface stack-ups, manufacturing, or in the field - when they’re far more expensive to fix.

That’s why we built F4 - the platform that analyzes GD&T to determine whether your designs are ready for production.

Drop in your drawing and 3D file. F4 analyzes every element of your GD&T to assess whether your design is clear, manufacturable, and production ready. To make the drawing easier to understand, engineers can visualize their datums, reference frames, and tolerance zones directly on the 3D model. F4 also calculates tolerance stack-ups instantly - directly from the drawing. What once took hours of manual work now takes seconds.

When issues are found, F4 flags them and guides engineers toward resolving the problem.

After analyzing your drawing, F4 also automatically generates design and inspection reports - stack-up tables, FAI reports - ready to share with your team.

And it does all of this locally on-device with no AI used for analysis. Producing deterministic results engineers can trust.

launches.tagline: We help hardware teams 10x how they redline & interpret engineering drawings
launches.body:
# **What is F4 in a nutshell?**

We’re helping hardware-rich teams 10x how they redline and interpret engineering GD&T drawings. With backgrounds at Tesla and SpaceX, we’re building a platform that finally treats drawings like code—automatically validating every dimension, tolerance, and GD&T symbol against standards so noncompliance is caught instantly.

https://youtu.be/SYzqZ4XWmCA

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=93123&key=user_uploads/2642473/a6d6c66e-7e58-4405-b4e2-48c30b354495)

# **The Problem & Why We Built F4**

Drawing literacy is one of the weakest skills across hardware teams. Yet drawings are made every day.

These aren’t just illustrations—they’re effectively business contracts between designers and manufacturers, defining what’s acceptable in production. Drawings carry the bulk of design intent—fit, form, function, and fabrication—and act as the important source of truth across production, quality, and supply chain.

GD&T standards from ASME and ISO exist to formalize this communication. But they’re dense and confusing. Across major revision years, there are thousands of pages of definitions, edge cases, and revision quirks. Designers are expected to know it all, leads are expected to catch every mistake, and suppliers are expected to interpret drawings flawlessly. One mistake means scrap, delays, or worse.

# **Our Solution**

Why is something so critical still so manual? Why can’t drawings be validated and interpreted more quickly and robustly —like code? Why can’t hardware dev be more like software dev?

We’re changing exactly that!

F4 treats drawings like code—they either execute or fail immediately. Our platform checks every dimension, tolerance, and GD&T symbol against standards in real-time, ensuring full compliance before a drawing ever reaches the floor. No more total reliance on manual redlining and reviews.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=93123&key=user_uploads/2642473/1aa5904c-3086-4722-8838-ffda9c0d7a85)

F4 ensures engineers never release noncompliant drawings—and suppliers never misinterpret them. F4 helps industrial teams eliminate costly scrap, rework, and miscommunication at the root.

# **How It Works**

1. Upload a drawing (dxf…and very soon pdf)
2. Select GD&T standard of choice (ASME Y14.5 - 1994, 2009, & 2018)
3. Get instant compliance score graded against a desired GD&T standard using **deterministic logic**
4. Get recommendation to correct any asset (FCF, FOS, datum, basic, modifier, and/or dimension) of the drawing that is noncompliant with references to ground-truth sources
5. With a compliant drawing - get standard definition, inspection plan, and tolerance analysis interpretations on any drawing asset of interest

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=93123&key=user_uploads/2642473/accc67da-db20-423d-84b0-7ec4904ad800)

## **Hardware Platform Built by Hardware Engineers!**

I worked at Tesla as a Mechanical Design Engineer and took 6 parts from clean sheet design to production for the CyberCab and SEMI drive system programs. I was also the lead engineer for Tesla’s global drive unit heat exchanger program with +3 million unit annual production volume.

Aidan worked at SpaceX as an Avionics Test Engineer, where he designed and owned testing hardware (PCB boards and testing apparatus) for the Raptor 3 Engine - the most advanced rocket engine in the world. 

In college, we led The University of Alabama’s Rocket Team where we achieved the university’s first-ever liquid rocket engine hotfire! I built the rocket engine and Aidan built the electrical/software for our propulsion system.

https://youtube.com/shorts/rBwsqu_sdeg?si=RgRU_eqib7_-qLcV

## **Ready to Ditch Manual Redlining?**

If you're tired of pretending to be good at GD&T:

* Email us: [paul@f4.dev](mailto:paul@f4.dev) and [cantu@f4.dev](mailto:cantu@f4.dev)

China and Russia control the world’s critical minerals. We can produce Titanium, Magnesium, Aluminum, Zirconium & Hafnium in the U.S. more profitably than any existing process, and carbon neutrally via co-production.

Carbochlorination is the primary process for producing critical metals like titanium, hafnium, and zirconium, and was once the standard for magnesium. The problem: conventional carbochlorination relies on purchasing carbon feedstocks, wastes valuable byproducts, and is highly CO₂-intensive.

Duranium changes this with a novel reactor that recycles CO₂ emissions back into feedstock (CO) while generating a valuable co-product (bleaching agents). This closed loop slashes emissions and delivers Chinese-level metal pricing without subsidies — unlocking the full potential of carbochlorination for U.S. critical mineral production.

launches.body:
![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=93706&key=user_uploads/2509424/cab46185-5d50-4822-bf45-873f52ae6571)

**TL;DR** — **China and Russia control world’s critical minerals. We can produce Titanium, Magnesium, Aluminum, Zirconium & Hafnium in the U.S. more profitably than any existing process, and carbon neutrally. On track to supply 12% of U.S. magnesium by 2029, at 50%+ EBITDA margins (@ world’s lowest mkt prices).**

Hi all, we’re Berkley and Brenden of Duranium, and we’re delivering American critical mineral independence with a light-weight metal production process that competes globally without subsidies. As brothers-in-law, we’re passionate about rebuilding the U.S. industrial base — not through taxes and subsidies, but through real technological innovation. Our mission is to help America reclaim its place as the world’s greatest builder of _tangible_ things.

# ❌ The Problem

Magnesium, titanium, aluminum, hafnium, and zirconium are all listed on the DOE’s Critical Minerals List, with magnesium ranked among the highest in both supply risk and strategic importance to U.S. energy security. _The U.S. has zero domestic magnesium production and no titanium sponge production — yet both are indispensable for fighter jets, missiles, satellites, rockets, and advanced aerospace systems._ 

China and Russia control \~97% of magnesium and \~90% of titanium production (directly or indirectly). 

On top of that, U.S. magnesium costs nearly 3x the global average, and legacy methods are CO₂-intensive and waste valuable byproducts.

# ✨ Our Solution

We’ve modernized carbochlorination metallurgy (the primary methods for producing many of these critical metals) with a novel reactor and process that:

* Creates a closed-loop system that profitably matches Chinese pricing — without subsidies — and slashes emissions
* Recycles CO₂ emissions into CO feedstock
* Generates a valuable co-product (bleaching agents)

Others are trying to reinvent lightweight metal production from scratch with approaches that are costly and dependent on government subsidies or green premiums to hit profitability. Our approach is different: we harness the laws of thermodynamics instead of fighting them, co-producing valuable outputs that make the economics best-in-class.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=93706&key=user_uploads/2509424/38fd63f0-e5a7-4f91-88cf-ad06c8b7e01a)

# 🏆 What we’ve achieved so far and where we’re headed

* We’ve proven the process at benchtop scale, producing magnesium, bleaching agents, and converting CO₂ produced by carbochlorination into CO
* We are now scaling with the build of a pilot facility to be operational by June 2026
* We’re on track to supply 12% of U.S. magnesium by 2029, at 50%+ EBITDA margins (@ world’s lowest mkt prices)

# 👥 Our Team

Berkley, CTO — A leading American expert in magnesium production; holds a patent for an electrochemical metal cell and built the _only_ U.S. pilot magnesium electrolyzer in the last 20+ years. Brings unmatched technical depth in lightweight metal production

Brenden, CEO — Former McKinsey D.C. consultant, where he advised the DoD on reshoring critical chemical production and spent 1 year with the Defense Logistics Agency (DLA). Ex-Goldman TMT investment banker, Stanford Law graduate and Knight-Hennessy Scholar

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=93706&key=user_uploads/2509424/babe8628-8537-44c5-aa1a-daecb483c077)

launches.title: Efference - Helping robots see like humans do
launches.tagline: Efference is building the most intelligent robotic camera on the market -- at half the cost.
launches.body:
![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95175&key=user_uploads/1945409/8214e17c-76b2-4c77-9b83-f11af13ff298)

Hey YC, I’m Gianluca. I’m building robotic cameras (stereo cameras) that treat vision as a software problem, not a hardware problem – just like humans do.\
\
We are actively taking pre-orders with delivery in March: https://efference.ai/preorder

[**https://youtu.be/0v0p2t3y4fI**](https://youtu.be/0v0p2t3y4fI)

Many robotics founders that I talk to are frustrated with current stereo cameras. They are expensive, require calibration, and still produce unreliable depth measurements despite their costs. Vision shouldn’t be an additional bottleneck when training robotic policies is already hard enough.

Our insight is that humans don’t have precise sensors: our eyes are noisy and imprecise but we run extremely sophisticated algorithms on top of them. Robotics already embraced this philosophy for arms (_cheap hardware + great algorithms_ → \[Zhao et al., 2023\]). We’re applying it to cameras by developing better algorithms.

What we built:

* A 3D perception model that combines stereo triangulation + learned priors about objects and environments.
* It runs in real time (unlike current neural depth approaches).
* We are distilling the model into our own hardware and shipping model wrappers for Realsense/ZED cameras so you can run these cameras better.

Check out the designs (going into production soon):

[**https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oOmf4k2ZwaY**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oOmf4k2ZwaY)

**Does it work?**

Self-Driving: [**https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0f058JAk64A**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0f058JAk64A)

Robotic Manipulation (via Functional Manipulation Benchmark): [**https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GyV12gqGOMY**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GyV12gqGOMY)

And many more demos coming to the YouTube channel: [https://www.youtube.com/@Efference](https://www.youtube.com/@Efference%5C)

**Why do we need this?**

Converting a vehicle to full autonomy can cost upwards of **$100,000**. The economics are terrible: the sensor stack dominates lifetime cost, keeping cost-per-mile high and slowing deployment. A stereo-vision stack like ours cuts that cost by **10–100×**. Lower integration cost → cheaper replacements → larger fleets → autonomy that scales. We know we can drive a car using a stereo camera because that is what humans use. It’s just a matter of getting the camera to work as well as the one humans have.

The same dynamic applies to humanoids, perhaps at an even greater scale. Companies like Unitree ship tens of thousands of robots every year, all with stereo cameras, and consumers often complain about quality. We’re building a camera that is both **affordable and usable**, so teams can actually build with it. As humanoid production scales to millions of units per year, we hope to be the camera that scales with it.

In urban drone environments, GPS fails. Reliable RGB-D depth enables SLAM, safe navigation, and collision avoidance; critical for companies like Skydio operating in urban valleys. Again, drones are another vertical that requires thousands of cameras per year that are cheap and effective.\
\
**Additional Background**

Any two-dimensional image is consistent with an infinite number of possible 3D worlds. “Seeing” is not just recording sensory input but resolving ambiguity; selecting the _most probable_ world given the available evidence **\[Born & Bencomo, 2021\]**.

Humans and nearly every other mammal have evolved the same solution to this problem over the past 500 million years of evolution: stereo triangulation + data-driven inference. We integrate every available depth cue – shadows, perspective, occlusions, and much more – along with what we know about objects and the environment to accurately represent 3D scenes and act accordingly.

Robots do not do this, but they need to.\
\
**Team**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95175&key=user_uploads/1945409/2474fb24-fae7-4604-a549-2a875fad6452)

I spent the past four years at Princeton (on-leave from PhD) studying foundational topics in machine learning and neuroscience. I funded my research by writing two successful NSF grants to build biologically-inspired vision models based on the **fruit fly connectome** where the general research direction for myself and certainly my collaborators was the question of **“how do we make this fruit fly live inside a computer simulation?”**

Prior to Princeton, I spent two years at Harvard Medical School studying visual decision-making in primate models and publishing influential theoretical work on **dopamine’s role in schizophrenia and its effects on visual perception**. I did my undergraduate degree in Biochemistry and got to do some cool non-vision work at the NASA Jet Propulsion Laboratory, figuring out a **new way of converting CO2 into O2 on Mars** that recycled water and did not require heat (e.g. MOXIE).

Generally, I like to work on really hard problems.

**The Ask**

If you’re a roboticist, I’d love to learn what vision requirements matter most to you. If you know teams in autonomous vehicles, drones, or humanoid robotics, and believe this product is cool, sharing / intros would mean a lot.

We are actively taking pre-orders with delivery in March: https://efference.ai/preorder

Thank you — Gianluca.

**\[Born & Bencomo, 2021\] [https://karger.com/bbe/article-abstract/95/5/272/47302/Illusions-Delusions-and-Your-Backwards-Bayesian](https://karger.com/bbe/article-abstract/95/5/272/47302/Illusions-Delusions-and-Your-Backwards-Bayesian)**

**\[Zhao et. al., 2023\] [https://arxiv.org/abs/2304.13705](https://arxiv.org/abs/2304.13705)**

launches.body:
# **Introduction**

Hi YC,\
\
We are [Tobias ](https://www.linkedin.com/in/tobifischer/)and [Sebastian](https://www.linkedin.com/in/sebafischer/). Cofounders (and brothers!) of [Wardstone](https://www.wardstone.space/).\
\
**TL;DR:** Wardstone builds satellites for missile defense. We are pursuing an emerging \~$40B/year space defense market as part of America’s Golden Dome initiative. Tobias studied Mechanical Engineering at Cornell and worked at Astranis. Sebastian studied Aerospace Engineering at MIT and worked at NASA, Lockheed Martin, Amazon, and Cruise. We built and demoed a live ground-based missile intercept during YC.

# **Launch Video**

Checkout the automated missile defense system we built during YC:

https://youtu.be/jXABTM9GZ6s

# **About Wardstone**

Wardstone builds space-based interceptors: satellites with interceptors designed to kinetically destroy missiles. New space threats, specifically hypersonic missiles, are emerging as existential threats to the United States. Our current missile defense systems were not designed for this new offensive technology. The United States’ Congress has allocated \~$25B towards developing new on-orbit hypersonic missile defensive missile capabilities over the next 3 years. Follow on build out of this on-orbit defensive layer coined the _Golden Dome_ has been estimated by congress to cost up to $831B over the next 20 years.\
\
At Wardstone, we believe that we can build defensive missile capabilities for a fraction of the cost of the offensive hypersonic weapons themselves, and orders of magnitude cheaper than the defensive concepts being proposed/explored by the major defense primes. We will do this with our first product, Hailstorm, that deploys high speed clouds of buckshot to kinetically destroy hypersonic missiles.

Our integrated interceptor-satellite constellation provides global intercept capabilities from space for various missile types beyond hypersonics. \
\
The success of Wardstone and the full deployment of the Golden Dome will place the United States in an incredibly strong geopolitical position.

The full Wardstone constellation with the space based intercept capability in action will look like this:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95440&key=user_uploads/2077453/f2a877a7-c23c-438d-8714-5a854930bba2)

# **Our Progress During YC**

During YC we had 2 main objectives: 1) build our first missile intercept demo and 2) establish relationships with our main customer: the US Space Force.\
\
**The Intercept Demo**\
We built a fully automated missile tracking and intercept system that uses infrared computer vision for predicting the future missile position and a high pressure air cannon to deploy an interceptor to destroy a 150+ mph missile. Our system provided repeatable behavior, could adapt to different missile speeds, and destroyed a total of 3 missiles. Checkout he video above for the entire story and insights into our system. Highlights below:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95440&key=user_uploads/2077453/c1d9b5df-8297-4a8a-aec8-a8529cb805e8)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95440&key=user_uploads/2077453/4ea3e37d-2172-4627-bd54-67a1f2374fe3)

**Space Force and Other Department of War Relationships**\
We built relationships and engaged with multiple agencies inside the military including: Air Force Research Labs, AFWERX, Space Systems Command Commercialization Office, Space Safari, and the Navy’s Joint Special Operations Command. We are receiving letters of support for an Air Force $3MM Space Based Interceptor SBIR grant and are receiving inbound requests for additional use cases of our technology (Ground to Air, Space to Ground).\
\
We have also engaged with five satellite bus and sounding rocket providers to integrate our Space Based Interceptors for our Series A demo milestone.\
\
If Space Defense Technology resonates with you, please reach out: [founders@wardstone.space](mailto:founders@wardstone.space).

launches.title: Allus AI — Vision Foundation Model for Manufacturing
launches.tagline: Bringing real intelligence to factories
launches.body:
Hi YC,

This is [Kai](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/1667481), [Shijie](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/2673772), and [Jason](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/2667730), cofounders of Allus AI.

We’re building a vision foundation model for manufacturing.

**TL;DR**: Traditional manufacturing vision systems are slow, complex, and expensive. Allus delivers a million-dollar vision solution in minutes.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pNV7Ekyzfm0

**A Vision Foundation Model for Manufacturing**

Allus is a 1B parameter vision foundation model trained on over 1.5 billion industrial, robotics, and manufacturing data pairs collected over five years. It achieves state-of-the-art accuracy in defect detection (> 99.95%) and process monitoring (> 99.2%).

Allus understands manufacturing the same way ChatGPT understands language. The dataset we used to train Allus is more than 100x larger than comparable industrial datasets, giving Allus a strong baseline familiarity with the entire factory ecosystem, including machines, people, and processes.

Today 95% of manufacturers still rely on manual inspection to detect defects and monitor process compliance on the factory floor. This work can be automated with computer vision, but these solutions are domain-specific, take months to implement and cost millions of dollars. 

With our implementation agent, Allus can be trained to handle specific use cases in only a few minutes using a small number of reference examples. 

In the last three months, we’ve deployed it on production lines run by five global fortune 500 manufacturers, where we’ve been able to improve defect detection accuracy in some cases by more than 100x.

**Our Team**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95347&key=user_uploads/1667481/c1a959c6-45ec-441b-b904-0ef212f17f53)

We combine cutting-edge AI with challenges that have troubled manufacturing for over a century. Kai, Shijie, and Jason began exploring how AI could empower industry while studying at Georgia Tech. Kai comes from a family deeply rooted in manufacturing and grew up in factories, managing production for IPhone back panel at the age of 18. Shijie previously worked as an LLM scientist at NVIDIA Lab, where he gained firsthand insight into the pain points of manufacturing. Jason has always operated on the front lines of industrial enterprises and developed universal solutions for robotics companies.

**Ask**

We’re working with manufacturers across the globe, from electronics and automotive to food & beverage, FMCG, and high-performance materials.

If you want to bring intelligence to your factory, talk to us!

👉 [Allus.ai](http://Allus.ai)

📧 [kai@allus.ai](mailto:kai@allus.ai)

launches.title: Tensr - Robotic Factories that Build Robots from Humanoids to Robots for the International Space Station
launches.tagline: Robotic Factories that Build Robots
launches.body:
Robotic factories building robots. Today we have a 12,000 sqft factory in the Bay Area manufacturing everything from full humanoids to robots for the International Space Station.

Our thesis: Revitalizing domestic manufacturing means driving costs down through automation. We are building an autonomous factory that is able to autonomously process a new order end to end from prototyping to large batch production. That means supply chain management, design for manufacturing, industrial machine retooling, robotic adaptation, quality inspection, packaging, and logistics all automated. Goal: Create a factory that can autonomously go from placed customer order to completed unit scale manufacturing run in 24 hours.

We are currently manufacturing production runs from top labs, full humanoids, and even have a partnership to manufacture robotics for the International Space Station. We've also built supply chain relationships in electronics, actuators, SMT, computing, pneumatics, and raw material suppliers.

A snippet of some of our machines in the factory:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=112228&key=user_uploads/2763027/777065e0-e83d-4501-8799-8c490e883851)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=112228&key=user_uploads/2763027/30775e59-e171-4949-b959-3dc06ffa5322)

## **Manufacturing at the Core**

This isn't just a robotic manipulation company. Its a manufacturing company.

Internally we have pipelines autonomous building large databases of actuators, and raw tracking and trying to predict what items will need to order now to meet our next day targets.

## **The Harness**

The entire factory is a data harness we can "backprop" learnings through from errors in the customer designs, failed supply chain prediction, slow retoolings, to inaccurate robotic manipulation. Our core belief is that robotic machine learning should not rely on human data to scale but instead learn to improve from its own mistakes in the real world in real time. This closes the manufacturing data gap that currently limits large-scale factory automation.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=112228&key=user_uploads/2763027/2baf7c74-80e3-49bb-a6bf-712ce0fb30fc)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=112228&key=user_uploads/2763027/4ed0acb3-e1bc-4210-b4d0-b3f3614bc8da)

## **Any Robot Anywhere**

Our thesis is simple. We should be able to make an robot for any environment whether that be a humanoid for the factory floor or a robot for Low Earth Orbit. We currently have a partnership with the ISS to manufacture a robots for the space station.

NASA Houston, Johnson Space Center

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=112228&key=user_uploads/2763027/e4558cfa-cf98-447a-acaf-7e83650e73a7)

## **Team**

At heart we're a team of Roboticists. Before Tensr we were the leads for a Berkeley lab's autonomous racing team where we raced autonomous full-scale IndyCars at over 160mph as the ML, Sim, and Robotic Controls leads.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=112228&key=user_uploads/2763027/c3772faa-f515-4ee0-b32e-2e586b3ae8e3)

We previously worked in industrial automation, aerospace manufacturing, medical device manufacturing, Berkeley AI Research (BAIR), physics simulation, and secured $17M+ in DARPA / industry sponsorship for UC Berkeley / Stanford research.

Our founding engineers range from Berkeley Robotics PhD, ex-NASA, to 10+ years of manufacturing experience.

## A Better World

On a personal note, not only do I believe we have the opportunity to build a great business but also to make a positive impact on the world. Automate away environmentally harmful materials, eliminate waste 0.1% at a time, and drive steady-state COGS toward only the fundamental inputs (materials and electricity), unlocking strong margins while collapsing the price of everyday goods / cost of living.

Lets build a better world :)

A full view of our vision here:[ tensr.com/whitepaper](https://www.tensr.com/whitepaper)

launches.title: Tensr: Building Autonomous Robotic Factories
launches.tagline: Building fully autonomous robotic factories that make scaling hardware as effortless as scaling on AWS
launches.body:
We're building fully autonomous robotics factories at Tensr to create the AWS of manufacturing. Our factories will receive on-demand orders from customers and spin up robots to operate industrial machinery, package, and ship the finished product all in 24 hours.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95506&key=user_uploads/2763027/704a7eb3-1ffc-4fc3-b806-32f3fd256418)

[**https://youtu.be/HLijIfoDfpA**](https://youtu.be/HLijIfoDfpA)

**Problem**

Moving fast in manufacturing today doesn't exist. Iterating designs for manufacturing takes months of back and forth getting samples from China and pre-ordering manufacturing capacity several months before the holiday rush, only then to wait several weeks for shipping praying there isn't a strike at the docks. At the same time we see the complete collapse of America industrial capacity as American workers and experience leave the field and contracts are sent overseas.

**Solution**

With the robotics revolution, for the first time it is possible to fully reimagine the factory floor - moving from rigid lines to modular stations, even in high mix settings. However, we believe that automating manufacturing is more than just deploying a foundation model or a humanoid into an existing factory.

Factories need to be designed from the ground up _around_ robots, not the other way around.

Over the past few weeks we turned our living room into an autonomous factory floor, with stations for CNC, moving stock, and a focus on assembly. After demo day, we'll expand to a full manufacturing facility, and start supporting batch orders of all sizes from other companies throughout the country. Currently we also are in talks to provide our own assembly models to other distributors.

In addition, our team brings direct operational experience from Rockwell Automation (industrial automation), aerospace manufacturing, and FDA-regulated medical-device production
